title: Marriage & Relationship Challenges
cardText: For couples and individuals whose relationship has drifted into distance, conflict, or quiet despair.
whatThisFeelsLike: The same fight keeps happening, or worse — the fights stopped and the silence moved in. You remember being close and don't know how to get back there.
howWeWork: Relationship work draws primarily on Emotionally Focused Therapy (EFT), which looks underneath the recurring arguments to the attachment needs driving them, alongside CBT tools for the patterns each partner brings. Sessions are available for couples together or for one partner working individually on the relationship. In person in West Chester or by telehealth for clients located in Ohio.
